articles.summary: Diemer brings decades of experience scaling innovation in energy storage systems SES AI Corporation (“SES AI”) (NYSE: SES), a global leader in the development and manufacturing of AI-enhanced high-performance Li-Metal and Li-ion batteries, today announced it has appointed Paul Diemer to the Company’s Board of Directors. Mr. Diemer previously served as Chief Technology Officer for Flex's Power business, where he led the global research and development and technology organizations responsible for embedded and critical power systems for AI datacenters, overseeing more than 1,000 engineers across 14 countries. In addition to Flex, Mr. Diemer previously oversaw new EV product architectures at BorgWarner and currently serves as SVP of Corporate Engineering at Generac Power Systems. articles.title: SES AI Appoints Paul Diemer to Board of Directors

articles.summary: Positions UZ Energy to Compete for Battery Sales Within Sol-Ark ® Eco-System Three UZ Energy Low-Voltage Residential Batteries Certified for Closed-Loop Compatibility US Energy Distributors Named Master Distributor and Primary U.S. Contact for UZ Energy SES AI Corporation (“SES AI”) (NYSE: SES), a global leader in the development and manufacturing of AI-enhanced high-performance Li-Metal and Li-ion batteries, today announced that UZ Energy, an SES AI company, has become a Sol-Ark® certified battery partner and has named US Energy Distributors as the master distributor for UZ Energy’s battery products in the United States. articles.title: SES AI’s UZ Energy Becomes Sol-Ark® Certified Battery Partner

articles.summary: Framework agreement targets up to $1,090,000 in several stages for designing battery systems, with options for expanded testing and serial production SES AI Corp. (NYSE: SES) (“SES AI” or the “Company”), a leader in AI-enhanced Li-Metal and Li-ion batteries, today announced that it has entered into a framework agreement with Doroni Aerospace, developer of the H1-X two-seat personal electric vertical takeoff and landing (eVTOL) aircraft, to design, develop, test and deliver a battery pack for Doroni Aerospace’s H1-X. The framework agreement establishes an aggregate price of up to $1,090,000, of which the initial tranche of $65,000 is committed, for work planned over multiple stages in 2026 and 2027, with each stage to be triggered by the issuance of a purchase order from Doroni to SES AI.
